Alle Stunden der Klasse :class in der Wo: All lessons of class :class in the week. The school administration enters changes.
Der Eintrag gibt der Lehrkraft keinen Zu: The entry gives the teacher no access to the class. For that, the school administration assigns them to the class.
Deine Stunden in der Woche, in allen Kla: Your lessons of the week, in all classes. The school administration enters changes.
Die Klasse hat in dieser Stunde schon ei: The class already has a subject in this lesson. Edit the existing entry.
Die Lehrkraft unterrichtet in dieser Stu: The teacher already teaches class :class in this lesson.
Your class’s lessons of the week. The school administration enters changes.
Fach, Lehrkraft und Raum je Klasse, Woch: Enter subject, teacher and room per class, weekday and lesson. Only the school administration maintains the timetables of its own school. A class has one entry per lesson, and a teacher is never in two classes at the same time. The entry gives the teacher no access to the class. The platform administration sees no timetables.
Für deine Klasse ist noch kein Stundenpl: No timetable has been entered for your class yet. The school administration maintains it.
Für diese Klasse ist noch kein Stundenpl: No timetable has been entered for this class yet. The school administration maintains it.
Für dich sind noch keine Stunden eingetr: No lessons have been entered for you yet. The school administration maintains the timetable.
Schüler:innen sehen den Plan ihrer Klass: Students see their class’s timetable, teachers their own lessons in all classes and the form teacher the whole timetable of their class, all read-only. The school administration sees all timetables of its own school.
Stunde in den Stundenplan eintragen: Add a lesson to the timetable
Trage die Stunden der Klassen ein. Schül: Enter the classes’ lessons. Students and teachers then see their timetable under “Timetable”.
Welche Klasse wann welches Fach hat, bei: Which class has which subject when, with whom and in which room. Students see their class’s timetable, teachers their own lessons.
Übernimmt Klasse und Fach aus deinem Stu: Takes class and subject from your timetable. You can still change both afterwards.
